UPDATE: Disregard anything I said about Windows Firewall. Still getting this bug after it's completely disabled.
This is unbelieveable. Gotten this network bug 13 times tonight. For the love of god fix this- VRChat is UNPLAYABLE.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
I cannot believe this bug still persists after what I just encountered.
Upon attempting to join my friends in an Avatar Museum 3 instance, I got this bug 12 OUT OF THE 14 TIMES I attempted to join the lobby. Of those times not a single player saw me.
As a quick-fix guess, I tried disabling my firewall. I relaunched the game, and I was able to actually connect properly.
So what the hell's going on? Is Windows Firewall seriously preventing VRChat from connecting? Is there something happening with initializing a world that causes upload initialization/sync to get blocked by the firewall?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Now I don't know anything technical about networking, but I do have a mild guess. Please take the following with a big grain of salt.
My personal guess is that the game is attempting to upload loads of packets to synchronize me, but something's getting blocked by the firewall, and when it comes to large worlds, the instance data has to get fed to the player, with every trigger, udon event, and other player already in the lobby. And with a firewall up, it'd probably limit some spamming upload-initialization packets, or if not, act as a filter to all sorts of packet data, and limit upload while it attempts to download, hogging traffic.
And it's not like anything's changed in my firewall settings to deny VRChat permissions at all. Only ever since the Udon Networking Update rolled out I've been getting this bug- haven't touched my firewall since.
Though I have never seen such a case where Windows Firewall can inconsistently block upload data. Especially when this bug only occurs at select times- there's worlds that don't have loads of things to initialize that still gives me this bug. Perhaps it's blocking the main, and using a fallback to attempt to connect me? But...why in the first place WOULD it even block it?
====================================================
Regardless, if this udon networking update is causing me to disable my firewall in order to actually play VRChat, this is a serious problem and seriously needs to be addressed. Nobody should have to risk their network security for this game to display their player-presence properly.
====================================================
Please devs, before you update your game, please fix what your previous updates broke. This is by far the WORST bug I've ever encountered in more than three years.

details:
Ever since this "Udon Network Update" There's been a VERY common bug where oftentimes, if a player joins a lobby, nobody that's already in the lobby will see, nor hear said player- essentially making them a ghost.
For me, I'll get this bug about 1 in 4 lobbies I join. Whether it's public, friends+, invite, whatever- I'll join a world fine on my end and literally nobody can see nor hear me. Often times I'll only know I have the bug if people are stepping in front of me or are completely ignorant of what I do. It's only after I reconnect that people will say "Oh where were you," after telling them I was trying to talk to them for the past 10 minutes.
When this incredibly annoying bug occurs, I'll have to either rejoin the instance- or block and unblock all the people already present in the world- those of who cannot see me.
There's even been times where I thought I had the bug (but didn't), rejoined the instance, then for real, actually got the bug when I reconnected.
And this isn't some per-person bug or anything. Word about this is going around everywhere. As for my own troubleshooting, changing the status of my firewall, restarting my router, changing router settings, network settings, network speeds, launching as administrator, etc., nothing that I can do from my end prevents this atrocious bug from occurring.
For example: I played VRChat last night and I joined a total of about 8 lobbies. In literally 3 out of those 8 lobbies I joined, nobody could see me. This is incredibly infuriating as I'll try to talk to my friends and chime into conversations, and they completely ignore me as I'm apparently not there for anybody who's already in the instance.
I'm not meaning to complain about the Udon Network Update, as I know there's a lot of intrepid creators taking advantage of its new syncing parameters and new netcode. But oh my God, this is the worst game-breaking update-bug that I've seen in 3 whole years. It almost makes VRChat unplayable.
If I can't "chat" in "VRChat" in 3 out of 8 lobbies, this is more than just a problem. Please fix this, and please soon.
title: Udon Network Update (UnU) Severely Broke Player Presence/Player Sync in Rooms/Lobbies/Worlds
